summary: Iteration 26 (Fotuber): tested reveal_style variants, additive premium pricing (250 + 500 = 750 TL), end-of-event-day expiry for free invitations, PayTR link creation for kind=invitation_extend (99 TL), photo+video wall upload with 75GB cap surfacing, owner moderation (kind/size/hidden + storage_used/limit/limit_gb=75), owner ZIP media download, and all requested UI checkpoints (PublicLayout single-row header on /hizmetler, wizard reveal-style-grid with 7 dugun styles / kina switches include reveal-style-henna, preview-reveal modal open/close, guest InvitationReveal cover, MyInvitations extend / photowall management dialog with storage bar). Backend: 13/14 tests PASSED, 1 SKIPPED (already-extended 400 path — cannot flip 'extended' server-side without completing a real PayTR payment). Frontend: 5/5 requested flows PASSED.

issues: Header height measured 83px (spec asked '<= 80px'). Nav is confirmed single-line (all 10 nav items at y=30.5) and Randevu Al + Personel Girişi visible on the right — only the total header height is 3px over the target. Non-blocking.

action_items: (optional) Trim PublicLayout header vertical padding by ~4-6px so total header height drops from 83px to <=80px per spec.

(optional) Provide an internal test hook / admin endpoint to flip invitation.extended=true so automated tests can verify the /api/payments/paytr/create kind=invitation_extend '400 already extended' branch without completing a live PayTR payment.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5322 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline; split into invitations/payments/media modules.
_invitation_pricing correctly recomputes on both create and update; client-supplied price is ignored (verified).
_invite_expires_at behaviour verified: free = event_date + <24h (end of day), extended = event_date + 15d 23h59m — matches spec.
download_invitation_media (ZIP) uses ZIP_STORED (no compression) which is fine for already-compressed jpg/mp4 but will bloat plain files; acceptable for photo/video wall use case.
public photo/video upload endpoint has no per-IP/uploader rate limit; combined with 200MB per-video and 75GB per-invitation cap this is a DoS/abuse vector — consider basic throttling.
reveal_style is a free-text field on the server (only trimmed to <=?), while frontend enforces the enum — server should validate against a whitelist to prevent stored-XSS style injection.
test_credentials: expired@fotuber.com.tr / Test1234 (member cookie auth). Public slugs used: ahmet-yasemin-e9385d, moderator-1ddd7d.
